description: The one call to make right before using a tool. Returns, in a single round-trip: is it healthy now (verdict + recommendation), a known-good input shape (recipe) for it, and — if it is down or risky — LIVE alternative tools that do the same job. Use this instead of calling check + recipe + alternatives separately. It tells you whether to proceed, how to call it, or what to call instead.

task.description: Optional coarse task tag to tailor the recipe/alternatives.

toolId.description: Tool you are about to call ('server' or 'server/tool_name').

name: prepare_tool_call
